title: Regulator dropout and current-limit fold-back

implements.text: A feed with reg gives min(reg, vin - dropout); a feed with drop gives vin - drop
A short on a rail fed through a current-limited regulator takes that rail and those it feeds to 0 V
Input above a feed's max burns the part

parameterSources.note: from the board figure, not cited to a datasheet

knownFailureCases: No test or reference run covers the power tree today, so the evidence supports no tier above T0
